spans.s:
f. (-या)
The practice of physic, curing, remedying.
E.
रुक् from रुच् disease, प्रतिक्रिया resisting.

Iron.
E.
रुच to shine, Uṇādi aff. मक्.

m. (-कः)
A gold-smith.
E.
रुक्म gold, and कारक a worker.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Golden.
f. (-वती)
A species of the Paṅkti metre.
E.
रुक्म, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-र्पः)
A name of BALARĀMA.
E.
रुक्मिन् a king, and दर्प pride; proud of overcoming him.

m. (-री)
BALARĀMA.
E.
रुक्मिन् a prince, and दारिन् destroyer.

m. (-क्मी)
The name of a prince slain by BALARĀMA.
f. (-क्मिणी)
1 The goddess LAKṢMĪ.
2 A princess carried off. and married by KṚṢṆA.
E.
रुक्म gold, and इनि poss. aff.

m. (-भिद्)
BALARĀMA.
E.
रुक्मि a prince, the elder brother of RUKMIṆĪ, and भिद् breaker, conqueror.

n. (-द्म)
Excrement, fæces.
E.
रुज् disease, सद्मन् abode.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
1 Harsh, unkind.
2 Rough, hard.
3 Rugged, uneven.
E.
रुह to grow, Uṇādi aff. स्; it is more properly written रूक्ष, as derived from रूक्ष to be rough.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
1 Harsh, rough, not smooth or soft.
2 Rough to the taste, astringent, austere, not bland or sapid.
3 Rugged, uneven.
4 Harsh, unkind, unfriendly.
m. (-क्षः)
A tree in general.
E.
रूक्ष to be harsh or rough, aff. क.

Harshness.
E.
रुक्ष, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, रूक्षत्वं.
